question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) as payment_month, SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    WHERE customer_id IN (526, 148, 144, 137, 178, 459, 469, 468, 236, 181)
    GROUP BY customer_id, payment_month
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        payment_month,
        monthly_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month_total,
        monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as month_diff
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    payment_month,
    ROUND(month_diff, 2) as max_diff,
    monthly_total,
    prev_month_total
FROM with_diff
WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month_diff DESC
LIMIT 1
